tools.name: jev_judge
tools.description: Ask agent-authored Choice, Score, or Noul questions over JSON state. Use this to try a new semantic predicate or scoring rubric; for repeated work, save a capability. Supplied state is available as item, and all questions here are independent.

state.description: JSON data. Use explicit fields and source references; never include API credentials.

propertyNames.description: Stable identifier, e.g. relevance or source_check.

type.description: Probability that a described condition holds.

instructions.description: Complete yes/no judgment, e.g. Does item.text address context.query?

type.description: Select one of the supplied labels.

instructions.description: Complete judgment to make from state.

propertyNames.description: Stable identifier, e.g. relevance or source_check.

criteria.description: Labels and their meanings; include a no-match outcome when appropriate.
Ordered definitions from lowest to highest; resulting score ranges from 0 to length minus 1.

additionalProperties.description: One typed Jev question. IDs are bookkeeping; put all meaning in instructions and criteria.

questions.description: Independent questions evaluated together over the same state.

maxCalls.description: Hard preflight limit on potential model calls; each may retry once on transient HTTP errors.

useCache.description: Reuse successful identical requests for up to one hour; outputs clearly identify cache hits. Disable for fresh evaluation.

tools.name: define_capability
tools.description: Save an agent-authored reusable Jev workflow with typed questions, conditional stages, selection, and ranking. A changed definition creates an immutable new version; an identical latest definition is reused. Definitions start unvalidated; evaluate examples before relying on them.

description.description: Purpose, intended use, and practical limitations.

Ordered definitions from lowest to highest; resulting score ranges from 0 to length minus 1.

additionalProperties.description: One typed Jev question. IDs are bookkeeping; put all meaning in instructions and criteria.

questions.description: Independent questions evaluated together over the same state.

when.description: All conditions must pass. Missing/skipped/error answers do not pass.

stage.description: Earlier stage whose answer supplies the value.

op.description: Exact label equality or numeric threshold comparison.

value.description: Choice label, Noul threshold in [0,1], or Score threshold.

stages.description: Ordered stages. Each sees item, context, and prior stage answers. Later stages can depend on earlier results.

select.description: All conditions must pass to select an item; omitted means all successfully completed items.

op.description: Exact label equality or numeric threshold comparison.

value.description: Choice label, Noul threshold in [0,1], or Score threshold.

rank.description: Optional numeric ranking after all stages.

stage.description: Stable identifier, e.g. relevance or source_check.

question.description: Stable identifier, e.g. relevance or source_check.

direction.description: Numeric sort direction; missing values sort last.

notes.description: Authored assumptions, provenance, or adaptation rationale; not evidence of effectiveness.

tools.name: get_capability
tools.description: Read an exact saved capability version, its questions, conditions, hash, and recent run/evaluation evidence. Omit version to retrieve latest; pin a returned version when comparing experiments. Reports remain attributed evidence rather than automatic validation.

version.description: Exact version; omit to resolve latest once at the beginning of the call.

tools.name: list_capabilities
tools.description: Find saved capabilities by name or description text. Returns current versions and an opaque cursor; reuse the same query with nextCursor to continue. Clear the cursor if the library changes.

query.description: Name or description substring; empty lists all.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from the same query; omit for first page.

tools.name: run_capability
tools.description: Apply a saved capability to a batch of source records, web results, memories, or arbitrary JSON items. Each item sees shared context and its own prior-stage answers. Returns selected IDs, ranks, cost, and runId; get_run retrieves all results or exact events. This makes Jev calls but executes no actions described in the data.

version.description: Exact version; omit to resolve latest once at the beginning of the call.

id.description: Unique stable item ID within a run.

data.description: JSON data. Use explicit fields and source references; never include API credentials.

items.description: Records with stable unique IDs and JSON data.

context.description: JSON data. Use explicit fields and source references; never include API credentials.

maxCalls.description: Hard preflight limit on potential model calls; each may retry once on transient HTTP errors.

useCache.description: Reuse successful identical requests for up to one hour; outputs clearly identify cache hits. Disable for fresh evaluation.

tools.name: evaluate_capability
tools.description: Test an exact capability against caller-authored examples using fresh Jev calls. Expected answer rules stay out of model input. Saves successes and failures against the pinned version; passing these examples does not independently validate the capability.

version.description: Exact version; omit to resolve latest once at the beginning of the call.

id.description: Stable identifier, e.g. relevance or source_check.

data.description: JSON data. Use explicit fields and source references; never include API credentials.

stage.description: Earlier stage whose answer supplies the value.

op.description: Exact label equality or numeric threshold comparison.

value.description: Choice label, Noul threshold in [0,1], or Score threshold.

expected.description: All expected answer comparisons must pass.

cases.description: Labelled examples, including negatives or boundary cases.

context.description: JSON data. Use explicit fields and source references; never include API credentials.

maxCalls.description: Hard preflight limit on potential model calls; each may retry once on transient HTTP errors.

tools.name: store_records
tools.description: Store source passages, methods, plans, or observations with explicit scope and source. Changed records receive a new version while old contents remain in history. This performs no model inference or external publication; superseded and cancelled records are excluded from search.

id.description: Stable record ID within its scope.

scope.description: Explicit collection or inquiry scope, e.g. skill_methods.

text.description: Original source passage or record text.

source.description: Source URL, document reference, or observation identifier.

kind.description: What the record represents; this role is preserved during retrieval.

status.description: Lifecycle gate; search returns active records only.

metadata.description: Optional provenance, dates, dependencies, or imported database fields.

records.description: Source-preserving records; IDs are unique within a scope.

tools.name: search_records
tools.description: Retrieve active records in one explicit scope using SQLite full-text search, optionally filtered by kind. Results preserve text, source, role, and version. Use empty query to browse, then run_capability for semantic filtering/ranking; this tool itself makes no Jev or embedding calls.

scope.description: Stable identifier, e.g. relevance or source_check.

query.description: Words to match; punctuation is treated as text, not query syntax.

kind.description: What the record represents; this role is preserved during retrieval.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from the same query; omit for first page.

tools.name: get_run
tools.description: Read a persisted run, pinned capability, costs, results, and reported outcomes. Paginate with nextCursor; set details=true for exact per-stage requests and responses. Use this to inspect failures, cache hits, or source-linked judgments before revising a capability.

runId.description: Run identifier returned by execution or evaluation.

details.description: Include exact stored per-stage request/response events.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from the same query; omit for first page.

tools.name: record_outcome
tools.description: Attach observed or reported downstream outcomes to a specific run and capability version. Include evidence references and limitations; the record remains attributed to the reporter. Use these records to guide later revisions without overwriting earlier evidence.

runId.description: Existing run to which this outcome belongs.

reporter.description: Who or what supplied this report.

description.description: What happened, including failures and uncertainty.

sources.description: Supporting observation, document, or tool-result references.
